BlackIce CW for Windows x64, focused on the camo library and saved configs.

- Browse and search 121 camo IDs with collection filters and favorites.
- Save and load named camo configs, import/export JSON libraries, and restore menu preferences across restarts.
- Existing config files retain their camo choices; unused extra fields are ignored and removed when saved or exported.
- Glass interface with a connect, choose and apply workflow.

Download `ColdWarCamoSwitcher-win-x64.zip`, extract it, and open `ColdWarCamoSwitcher.exe`. The .NET runtime is included. Equip an available Shards camo before connecting, then follow the bundled `READ-ME-FIRST.md`.

Game Pass camo compatibility remains experimental and unverified in the actual game. This release does not permanently unlock camos, force-save an online profile, or edit offline save files.

The Windows workflow verifies the core/config behavior, native process-memory fixtures, build-report helper and menu UI. The download checksum is in `SHA256SUMS`.
